rounds.label: Rounds before long break
rounds.description: Focus sessions in one cycle before a long break.

auto-start-breaks.label: Auto-start breaks
auto-start-breaks.description: Start the break as soon as a focus session ends.

auto-start-work.label: Auto-start focus
auto-start-work.description: Start the next focus session as soon as a break ends.

daily-goal-minutes.label: Daily goal (minutes)
daily-goal-minutes.description: Focus minutes per day you aim for. Set 0 to hide the goal.

log-partial.label: Log interrupted sessions
log-partial.description: Count focus time from sessions you skip or reset (one minute or more).

notify.label: Notifications
notify.description: Show a notification when a session or break ends.

sound.label: Sound
sound.description: Play a sound when a session or break ends.

show-idle-count.label: Show today's count when idle
show-idle-count.description: Show how many sessions you finished today while the timer is idle.

show-progress.label: Show progress line
show-progress.description: Show a thin progress line under the countdown.
